# IPO Intelligence (IPOIntel)

> IPOIntel is evidence-first IPO research for India and the United States: filings, valuation, institutional demand and historical evidence, with separate listing-gain and long-term signals. It is research and decision support only, not investment advice. IPOIntel is a Brandsap product, built by Satyam Pandey.

Live site: https://ipointel.brandsap.com/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ipointel.brandsap.com/): product overview, methodology and track record
- [Dashboard](https://ipointel.brandsap.com/dashboard/): browse tracked IPOs
- [Privacy](https://ipointel.brandsap.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://ipointel.brandsap.com/terms)
- [Sitemap](https://ipointel.brandsap.com/sitemap.xml): includes one page per published IPO
